Quick internal note —

I reviewed the MAP v3. High-level pricing calls out:
- 3 new teams at conservative utilization => +18% ARR run-rate if all pilots convert
- Embeddings pilot (single team) incremental $6k/mo during pilot; full rollout TBD
- 24x7 Priority Support add-on: fixed $15k/mo or tiered SLA-based pricing; needs legal T&Cs.

Stephanie: can you start a SOW draft covering: the three-team onboarding scope, embeddings pilot acceptance criteria, and the priority support terms? Aim for an internal draft by 2027-02-16 so we can share with procurement. I'll prepare the pricing range for the renewal update and share by 2027-02-11.
